message.lightsabersfork.force_silence: Yer black-hearted Voodoo be locked in Davy Jones' chest!

message.lightsabersfork.kata_meditation_: ✦ Restin' with yer cutlass sharpens yer piratin' form! §e(+1 AP)
message.lightsabersfork.milestone_double: ✦ Double-ended glow-cutlass forged, by Blackbeard! §e(+1 AP)
message.lightsabersfork.first_lightsaber: ✦ Yer first Glowin' Cutlass be forged! The winds o' Voodoo fill yer sails. §e(+1 FP)
message.lightsabersfork.unstable_overhea: Arrgh! Yer volatile cutlass boiled over and snuffed itself out!
message.lightsabersfork.tk_boss_too_stro: Even with Level III, this sea monster be too hefty!
message.lightsabersfork.tk_req_level_2: Sea-Sorcery Level II needed to heave breathin' scallywags!
message.lightsabersfork.tk_req_level_3: Sea-Sorcery Level III needed to heave cursed beasts!
message.lightsabersfork.tk_block_too_hea: This timber be too heavy for yer sorcery!
message.lightsabersfork.dash_ground_requ: Plant yer peg-leg on deck before dashin' again!

message.lightsabersfork.force_silenced: Yer mystic sea-tide be cursed and muffled!

gui.lightsabersfork.radial.amfi.singular: §6[Tier IV - Maelstrom Keelhaul] §eDrags and crushes all souls into an abyss whirlpool at 38 paces!
Mind yer helm, matey! Signing onto the Cartographer's Guild or the Brig Guards takes all yer salt — hoisting one flag sinks the other fer good. Ready to sign in blood?
The Abyss takes no cowards! Pick tween the storm-witchery o' the Inquisitors or the cutthroat shadows o' the Assassins. The other port burns forever. Sign the articles — no turning back!
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_block.title: Parry
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_block.desc: Lets ye parry with right-click. 35% chance to swat musket balls, 50% fer enemy cutlasses.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_better_block.de: 50% chance to swat musket balls, 70% fer cutlasses.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_adv_block.title: Master Bosun's Parry
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_throw.title: Fling Cutlass
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_throw.desc: Hurl yer glowin' blade across the deck (Max. 12 paces). Cleaves 2 paces wide.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_focusing.title: Gem Eye
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_focusing.desc: Awakens the hidden sea-curses inside yer fitted cutlass gems.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_kyber_resonance: +1 extra sting with yer Glowin' Cutlass.
skill.lightsabersfork.ls_lethal_precisio: +3 extra sting with yer Glowin' Cutlass.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_better_form.des: +1.75 paces lunge reach, 15% harder to knock overboard.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_speed.title: Quick Slash
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_better_throw.de: 24 paces fling reach and 3 paces cleave width.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_throw.title: Kraken-Slayer's Fling
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_adv_throw.desc: 32 paces fling reach and 5 paces cleave width.
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_ult_speed.title: Frenzied Boarding
skill.lightsabersfork.sb_ult_speed.desc: Brings back the olden days o' 1.8 brawlin' (Swing as fast as ye please!).
skill.lightsabersfork.db_better_form.des: +1.75 paces lunge reach, 15% harder to knock overboard.
skill.lightsabersfork.db_adv_form.title: Quartermaster's Stance
skill.lightsabersfork.db_adv_form.desc: +0.5 paces reach, +1 sting, 15% harder to knock overboard.
skill.lightsabersfork.db_single_switch.d: Douse one end o' yer twin-blade to catch scallywags off guard.
skill.lightsabersfork.db_ult_block.title: Ironclad Wall
skill.lightsabersfork.db_ult_block.desc: Swats 100% o' flying lead and parries 90% o' enemy cutlasses.
Opens yer weather-eye to the mystic winds o' the Voodoo.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_adept.title: Voodoo Deckhand
skill.lightsabersfork.force_adept.desc: Deepens yer lungs, lettin' ye hold more Voodoo Wind.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_channeler.de: Catches the breeze faster, refillin' yer Voodoo in a jiffy.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_veteran.desc: Vastly widens yer Voodoo stores through boarding and rum-ponderin'.
skill.lightsabersfork.force_mastery.desc: Commands the raw fury o' the mystic tides.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_initiate.desc: Takes yer first steps under the Privateer's Articles.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_padawan.title: First Mate's Pup
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_padawan.desc: Schooled by an old captain. Grants grit and a steady hand.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_knight.title: High-Seas Privateer
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_knight.desc: Sworn protector o' the trade lanes and keeper o' the Fair Winds.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_librarian.des: Keepin' the ancient sea charts. Greatly swells yer Voodoo pool and ponderin'.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_guard.title: Brig Sentinel
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_guard.desc: Sturdy as an oak hull. Bolsters yer armor, footing, and wards.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_master.title: Commodore
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_master.desc: Breathes a calm breeze that mends yer crew and wards off curses.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_council.title: Brethren Court
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_council.desc: A lord o' the Fleet. The Sea itself steps in to spare ye from a fatal blow.
skill.lightsabersfork.jedi_grandmaster.d: One with the Seven Seas. Undead scurvy-dogs flee and Voodoo costs less wind.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_hopeful.title: Bilge Rat
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_hopeful.desc: Sparks the black fire o' greed and mutiny.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_acolyte.title: Bloodthirsty Swab
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_acolyte.desc: Feeds on slaughter. Sending foes to Davy Jones grants a burst o' speed.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_warrior.title: Boarding Butcher
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_warrior.desc: Shows no quarter, cutting down wounded dogs with savage swings.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_inquisitor.de: Masters foul sea-witchery. Squall-lightning jumps tween multiple lubbers.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_assassin.desc: Strikes from the fog with a wickedly lethal backstab.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_master.title: Dread Captain
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_master.desc: Strikes terror into all nearby lubbers, turnin' their knees to jelly.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_council.title: Scourge o' the Court
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_council.desc: Lubbers slain by yer black Voodoo blow up like a powder keg.
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_emperor.title: King o' the Black Flag
skill.lightsabersfork.sith_emperor.desc: All the oceans bow to ye! Yer dark curses punch right through any armor.
power.lightsabersfork.force_push.desc: Summon a fierce squall to blow scallywags off the poop deck.
power.lightsabersfork.force_pull.desc: Whip up a whirlpool in the air to haul lubbers and booty straight to yer hooks.
power.lightsabersfork.force_dash.desc: Catch a phantom tailwind in yer boots to dart ahead in a flash.
power.lightsabersfork.force_jump.desc: Bound high into the riggin' with a Voodoo-blessed leap.
power.lightsabersfork.force_jump.secret: §e[Secret] Charge yer leap for sky-high flight; ignores deck crashes!
power.lightsabersfork.force_stasis.desc: Drop anchor on foes and freeze flyin' cannon shot dead in the air.
power.lightsabersfork.force_stasis.secre: §b[Secret] Suspends flyin' bolts and freezes boarding parties stiff!
power.lightsabersfork.force_slam.desc: Smash foes into the deck with brutal kinetic broadside.
power.lightsabersfork.force_slam.secret: §6[Secret] Shatters bucklers and shakes the sea floor with tremors!
power.lightsabersfork.force_heal.desc: Call upon Fair Winds to stitch up yer flesh faster than the ship's surgeon.
power.lightsabersfork.force_heal.secret: §a[Hidden Lore] Scrubs away curses and patches up yer crewmates.
power.lightsabersfork.force_repulse.desc: Unleash a 360-degree maelstrom that blasts all boarders into the sea.
power.lightsabersfork.force_lightning.de: Shoot foul, crackling storm-lightning straight from yer fingertips.
power.lightsabersfork.force_lightning.se: §c[Hidden Lore] Turns townsfolk and dead men into fouler beasts!
power.lightsabersfork.electric_judgement: Stun mutineers in their tracks with righteous golden lightning.
§b[Hidden Lore] Cures zombie-rot and scorches Buccaneers!
power.lightsabersfork.force_choke.desc: Tighten an unseen hempen rope round yer foe's gullet from afar.
power.lightsabersfork.force_choke.secret: §c[Hidden Lore] Chokes 'em right through their iron plate!
power.lightsabersfork.force_drain.desc: Siphon the very life-salt out o' yer mark to fill yer own belly.
Heave and fling heavy cargo through the air without layin' a finger on it.
power.lightsabersfork.force_barrier.desc: Summon a mystic shield o' sea-force to soak incoming broadsides.
power.lightsabersfork.force_barrier.secr: §b[Secret] Deflects cannon shot and balloons into an impenetrable diving bell!
power.lightsabersfork.force_fortify.desc: Raise a shimmering bulkhead o' pure Voodoo round yer hide.
power.lightsabersfork.force_sight.desc: Spot stowaways and shipmates right through solid timber and stone.
power.lightsabersfork.force_stealth.desc: Vanish into the sea-mist so neither monsters nor rival pirates can spy ye.
advancements.lightsabersfork.root.title: Beyond the Edge o' the Map...
advancements.lightsabersfork.root.desc: Plunder yer first Kyber Gem from ancient wrecks, temples, or deep caverns.
advancements.lightsabersfork.crystal_pou: Stitch a Booty Sack from hide and twine to stow all 18 Kyber Gems.
advancements.lightsabersfork.craft_circu: Tinker together Cutlass Riggin' using iron, diamonds, and red powder.
advancements.lightsabersfork.craft_forge: Build a Cutlass Smiddy out o' Reefstone and iron ingots.
advancements.lightsabersfork.first_light: Rig together yer very first Glowin' Cutlass inside the smiddy.
advancements.lightsabersfork.double_sabe: Lash two Glowin' Cutlasses together at a workbench to make a twin-bladed staff.
advancements.lightsabersfork.combat_mast: Send scallywags to Davy Jones with a lit cutlass to earn Swashbucklin' Points.
advancements.lightsabersfork.find_holocr: Plunder an ancient Glow-Box from stronghold libraries or sunken ruins.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_first_: Sail under Fair Winds and claim yer first Privateer Voodoo trick.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_all_sk: Master the Fair Winds and rise to the station o' Commodore.
advancements.lightsabersfork.jedi_grandm: Claim every tier o' the Fair Winds and command the Privateer Fleet.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_first_: Hoist the Black Flag and unlock yer first Buccaneer curse.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_all_sk: Learn the foul arts o' treachery and cannon-fire to become a Dread Captain.
advancements.lightsabersfork.sith_empero: Bring the Seven Seas to their knees and seize the throne as Pirate King.
advancements.lightsabersfork.elixir_resp: Brew and swig a Bilge-Wash Grog to chart a new course in the Voodoo.
Conquer both the Fair Winds as Grand Admiral and the Abyss as Pirate King.
